lines.text: The high priest asks Stephen if the charges are true, and Stephen says God appeared to Abraham in Mesopotamia.
Abraham leaves the land of the Chaldeans, receives no inheritance there, and God gives him the covenant of circumcision.
Jealous brothers sell Joseph into Egypt, and Pharaoh makes him ruler there, so Joseph later sends for his family of seventy in all.
A new king oppresses Israel, Pharaoh's daughter raises Moses, and after he kills an Egyptian, Moses flees to the land of Moab.
An angel appears to Moses in a burning bush, but later the people make a calf, and God warns of exile beyond Babylon.
